cards.title: Repo scaffold, toolchain pins and formatting
cards.description: Create the working tree: .gitignore, .python-version (3.12), pyproject.toml driven by uv, ruff config, package.json + tsconfig for the site, astro.config.mjs, .env.example, .editorconfig. Nothing in this card may contain retailer logic or product data.
acceptance: `uv sync` succeeds from a clean clone and produces uv.lock
`npm ci` succeeds from a clean clone and produces package-lock.json
`ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass on the empty tree
`.env.example` documents every variable the pipeline reads, with no real values
`.gitignore` excludes .env, node_modules, dist, .astro, __pycache__, .venv
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Pydantic domain models and JSON Schema export
cards.description: Implement scripts/models/ with Pydantic v2 models for Product, Seller, Offer, EducationOffer, GiftCardOffer, Deal, MatchCandidate, RunManifest, PurchaseRoute. Field names and enums must match docs/DATA-MODEL.md exactly. Extra fields on the canonical shapes from the product spec are additive only.
acceptance: All ten models import from scripts.models and validate the documented examples
Enum values are enforced for category, seller_type, stock_status, price_basis, promotion_type, verification_status, deal_type, match_method
`python -m scripts.models.export_schema` writes JSON Schema to data/schema/
`mypy --strict scripts/models` passes
Invalid prices (negative, non-numeric, wrong currency) are rejected with a typed error
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Validation CLI with hard and soft failures
cards.description: scripts/validation/validate_data.py validates every committed dataset against the models plus dataset-level invariants. Hard failures must stop a deploy; soft failures must surface as warnings in the report and the job summary.
acceptance: Exit code 0 on a clean tree, 1 on any hard failure, 2 on unexpected crash
`--json` emits a machine-readable report consumed by later workflows
Referential integrity is enforced: every offer product_id exists in products.json, every seller_id exists in sellers.json
Freshness fields are required on every offer: captured_at, source_hash, verification_status
Hard-failure paths are covered by tests and produce actionable messages naming the file and field
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Seller registry with 21 documented sellers
cards.description: data/sellers.json holds every Phase 1, Phase 2 and business/education source with all twelve required attributes from the plan plus capability flags. Phase 2 sellers are present but disabled, with an explicit reason. No seller is enabled on a guess: enabled sources need a policy decision recorded.
acceptance: All 21 sources present with stable seller_id values matching the plan's numbering

Every entry has: display name, seller_type, website, search URL, country, regions, categories, collection method, rate limit, crawl delay, authorised status + evidence URL, warranty/returns/delivery URLs, trust inputs, adapter module, enabled flag
Enabled sellers are exactly the Phase 1 consumer set that the collection posture permits
Each disabled seller carries enabled_reason explaining what would enable it
Registry validates against the Seller model and is covered by a test
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Seed catalogue: 20 products with evidenced Apple AU RRP
cards.description: data/products.json seeds 20 products spanning Mac, iPad, iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV, HomePod and accessories. Every RRP must be captured from an Apple AU page with the source URL and capture timestamp recorded. Do not invent a price: if a page cannot be read, mark the product rrp_verification as unverified and record what blocked it.
acceptance: 20 products validate against the Product model
Coverage spans at least 6 of the 9 categories
Every product has apple_au_url, apple_sku where Apple publishes one, and a priced RRP with evidence_url and captured_at
Configuration objects are complete enough to disambiguate storage, memory and colour variants
education_eligible is set from Apple's own education eligibility, not assumed
A test asserts no duplicate product_id and no null RRP without an unverified marker
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Dataset invariant checks and freshness policy
cards.description: Codify the 'never present an unverified price as current' rule as executable policy: per-seller freshness_max_age_hours, automatic stale marking, and a guard that refuses to publish an offer whose age exceeds its threshold without the stale marker.
acceptance: config/freshness.yml defines thresholds per seller type and per source class
A helper computes effective verification_status from captured_at and the threshold
Tests cover fresh, boundary and stale cases
Any offer past its threshold is rendered as indicative by the site contract (field present in output)

cards.title: Test suite foundation and coverage gate
cards.description: Stand up tests/ with pytest, respx and coverage config. This card owns the harness, not other cards' tests: schema/model/validation tests belong to apple-data, site tests to apple-web, workflow tests to apple-qa.
acceptance: `pytest -q` runs with no network access and passes
Coverage config excludes generated files and reports per-module
A failing validation fixture is proven to fail the suite
tests/conftest.py provides reusable loaders for data/*.json and fixtures/

cards.title: Docs wave 1: README, architecture, data model, registry, brand
cards.description: Write the implementation-ready documents for what actually exists after M1. No aspirational features: if it is not built, it belongs in ROADMAP.md as future work. Include the provisional brand decision and the rename checklist.
acceptance: README.md: what it is, what it is not, quickstart, repo map, disclaimers
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: pipeline stages, trust boundaries, isolation model, why no database
docs/DATA-MODEL.md: every entity, every field, the SQLite target DDL, migration path
docs/SOURCE-REGISTRY.md: all 21 sources, safest method, policy status, what would enable Phase 2
docs/BRAND.md: provisional brand, trademark position, rename checklist
AGENTS.md: team, board usage, non-negotiables, how to work a card
Australian English throughout; no marketing filler
notes: Director verified: 29/29 seller ids present, no fabricated sellers, money documented as numbers, field list matches data/schema

cards.title: Astro scaffold with Tailwind and an empty build
cards.description: Create the Astro 5 project with Tailwind 4, a base layout, design tokens and a placeholder home page. The build must pass and deploy an empty-but-valid site. No fabricated data on the page.
acceptance: `npm run build` produces site/dist with a valid index.html
Tailwind is wired and a design token file defines the palette and type scale
BaseLayout sets lang="en-AU", viewport, and the not-affiliated disclaimer slot
No page renders a price that does not come from data/*.json
Build runs offline
notes: Director verified: tests + validate_data + build green

cards.title: Kanban, agent team definitions and CI skeleton
cards.description: The board, the director and specialist agent definitions, and the first validate-data workflow stub so the team has a shared source of truth and a gate from day one.
acceptance: `.kanban/kanban.py` supports list/show/next/claim/move/block/add/stats/render
board.json seeds every milestone card with acceptance criteria
`.opencode/agents/` defines apple-director plus six specialists with disjoint file ownership
`.github/workflows/validate-data.yml` runs the validation CLI on push and PR
AGENTS.md documents the flow: backlog -> ready -> in_progress -> in_review -> done
notes: workflow still missing; reassigned to apple-qa

cards.title: Apple AU collector: JSON-LD with HTML fallback
cards.description: Collect Apple AU product pages for the catalogue. Prefer JSON-LD Product/Offer blocks; fall back to server-rendered markup. Record availability, promotions and the product URL. No JavaScript execution.
acceptance: Parses name, price, availability and URL from saved fixtures for every seeded product
Promotion is recorded only when present in the markup, never inferred from a date
Unparseable page raises a typed ParseError captured per product, not a crash
Fixture-based tests pass with the network disabled

cards.title: Apple Education collector and eligibility metadata
cards.description: Collect apple.com/au-edu/store pricing and derive saving_aud and saving_pct against the standard price. Record UNiDAYS verification and Apple's stated purchase limits as metadata with source URLs. Verify live how pricing is displayed before asserting it in docs.
acceptance: Education offers validate against EducationOffer including standard_price_aud, saving_aud, saving_pct
eligibility array matches Apple's published categories
annual_limit_summary is sourced from Apple, not paraphrased from memory
saving_pct recomputation is asserted in a test to two decimal places
Observed behaviour of the store (public price display vs gated) is written into SOURCE-REGISTRY.md

cards.title: Product normaliser and deterministic product_id
cards.description: Normalise Apple titles into the canonical product_id slug and configuration object. Deterministic and idempotent: the same input always yields the same identifier, and a rename never silently changes one.
acceptance: product_id format is stable and documented in DATA-MODEL.md
Storage/memory/colour normalisation handles Apple's abbreviations (e.g. 16GB vs 16 GB)
Collision cases are tested; a collision raises rather than overwriting
Re-running the normaliser over the catalogue is a no-op (idempotency test)

cards.title: Full Apple AU catalogue generation
cards.description: Expand the seed catalogue to the full current Apple AU range using the collector output rather than hand entry. Generation must be diffable and idempotent.
acceptance: Catalogue covers every active Apple AU category in scope
Generation is idempotent: a second run produces no diff
Discontinued products are marked superseded, not deleted
Catalogue size and category counts reported in the run summary

cards.title: Snapshot writer with hashing and run manifest
cards.description: Write immutable daily snapshots to data/snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD/<seller_id>.json with sha256 source hashes and a run manifest in data/runs/ recording fetched/parsed/matched/rejected counts.
acceptance: Snapshots are append-only: an existing file is never silently overwritten
Every offer carries source_hash and run_id
Run manifest validates against RunManifest and is written even when the run fails
Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601; display timezone is applied only at render

cards.title: M2 review gate: verify 5 products against Apple AU
cards.description: Human checkpoint. Pick five products at random from the generated catalogue and compare name, price and URL against apple.com/au. Record the comparison in docs/reports/ so the gate is auditable.
acceptance: Five products compared field by field with screenshots or saved HTML as evidence
Any mismatch is logged as a card rather than quietly corrected
Result recorded in docs/reports/m2-gate.md with date and reviewer

cards.title: SourceAdapter protocol, rate limiter and robots gate
cards.description: One protocol every adapter implements, with a token-bucket rate limiter, per-source crawl delay, conditional requests, retries with jitter, a disk cache and a robots.txt gate that runs before any fetch.
acceptance: RobotsDenied is a distinct outcome from a network error and is recorded as blocked_by_policy
Rate limiter is unit-tested against a virtual clock
Retries are bounded, jittered, and never retry a 403 into oblivion
A denied fetch cannot fall through to a parser

cards.title: JB Hi-Fi adapter with recorded policy decision
cards.description: Implement JB Hi-Fi per the hybrid posture. Card requires a written policy check: if robots.txt or terms restrict automated collection, ship the curated path and record the decision. Do not build a bypass.
acceptance: Policy check result recorded in adapter_health and SOURCE-REGISTRY.md
Adapter parses saved fixtures or the curated feed into valid Offer records
2+ fixtures cover price present, price absent, and out-of-stock
No CAPTCHA, fingerprint or bot-protection circumvention exists anywhere in the module

cards.title: Officeworks adapter
cards.description: Low-rate adapter for Officeworks with pickup availability captured where the page exposes it.
acceptance: Parses price, stock status and pickup availability from fixtures
Crawl delay respects the registry entry (1 request / 3s)
Fixture tests cover in-stock, out-of-stock and price-with-was-price

cards.title: Harvey Norman adapter
cards.description: Adapter for Harvey Norman with per-store stock noise reduced to a single national stock status.
acceptance: National stock status derived deterministically from per-store data
Fixtures cover multi-store stock variance
Store-specific prices are never merged into one offer

cards.title: The Good Guys adapter
cards.description: The Good Guys shares a corporate group with JB Hi-Fi; reuse the policy finding and the adapter shape where the markup permits.
acceptance: Policy decision recorded and cross-referenced with the JB Hi-Fi decision
Fixtures cover a clearance listing and a bundle listing
Bundles never masquerade as a bare product price

cards.title: Bing Lee adapter
cards.description: Low-rate adapter for Bing Lee.
acceptance: Parses price and stock from fixtures
Crawl delay respects the registry
Out-of-stock fixture covered

cards.title: Beyond the Box adapter
cards.description: Adapter for the specialist reseller Beyond the Box.
acceptance: Parses price and stock from fixtures
Specialist seller type carries its trust score inputs
Fixture tests pass

cards.title: Mobileciti adapter with grey-import safeguards
cards.description: Mobileciti sells imported stock. Offers must carry a grey-import flag and stricter validation before they can rank above an authorised reseller.
acceptance: Grey-import risk is recorded as a structured field, not a footnote
Warranty source (Apple AU vs seller) is captured where stated
An imported offer cannot be published as the best price without the flag visible

cards.title: Amazon AU adapter with marketplace safeguards
cards.description: Amazon AU is a marketplace. Only Amazon-sold or explicitly trusted third-party sellers may publish; everything else goes to review. Prefer an official API path if credentials exist.
acceptance: sold_by is captured and enforced: non-Amazon sellers require a trust score above threshold
Third-party listings default to needs_review rather than published
Fixtures cover Amazon-sold, third-party, and used-condition listings
Used or refurbished items never match a new-product offer

cards.title: Layered product matching engine
cards.description: Implement the five layers in order: Apple SKU, GTIN/EAN, normalised configuration, fuzzy title with confidence, manual review. A match records method, confidence, normalised title and a configuration diff.
acceptance: Layer order is enforced and tested: a SKU hit never falls through to fuzzy
Confidence is deterministic for identical inputs
Configuration diffs list every mismatched field
Any match below 0.85 is withheld from latest_offers.json

cards.title: Review queue and manual override file
cards.description: Uncertain matches land in data/matching/review_queue.json. Approvals and rejections are recorded in overrides.json and survive re-collection.
acceptance: Review queue entries carry the evidence needed to decide: raw title, price, proposed product, diff
Overrides are applied before publishing and are never overwritten by a later run
A rejected candidate cannot re-enter the queue without a changed source_hash
Queue size delta is reported in every run summary

cards.title: Publish latest_offers.json with confidence reporting
cards.description: Assemble the published offer set for the site with best-price-per-product derivations and a per-seller confidence distribution report.
acceptance: latest_offers.json validates and contains only published-confidence offers
Best price per product is derived, never hand-written
Per-seller confidence distribution written to data/health/
Sort order is stable across runs (no diff noise)

cards.title: Price-history engine with all-time low detection
cards.description: Derive per-product and per-seller series from snapshots. Compute all-time low, lowest-ever across sellers, and previous-captured price. Recomputation must be idempotent.
acceptance: Series derive only from committed snapshots, never from latest_offers
ATL and lowest-ever-across-sellers are computed and unit-tested on synthetic series
Out-of-stock periods do not register as price drops
Compact series written to data/history/<product_id>.json for charting

cards.title: Deal engine with configurable thresholds
cards.description: Deterministic deal detection covering price drop, RRP discount, all-time low, education saving, gift-card and cashback effective discount, bundle value, clearance and restock. Thresholds live in config/deal_rules.yml and every deal records its rule_version.
acceptance: Every deal carries all eleven required fields including confidence and evidence URL
Golden-file tests on a synthetic 60-day series
A deal with an expired promotion is not published as current
Changing a threshold changes the output, proven by test
No deal is emitted without an evidence URL and captured_at

cards.title: Gift-card schema and effective-price calculator
cards.description: Implement GiftCardOffer plus a pure calculator for effective purchase price after gift-card discount, cashback and loyalty points. Points are valued at a documented, configurable rate and never presented as cash.
acceptance: effective_discount_pct is asserted equal to (face - effective)/face within 0.01
Points valuation is configurable and surfaced in output, never hard-coded silently
Calculator refuses to double-count a route (gift card + cashback on the same spend)
Property-based tests: no negative effective price, no discount above face value
Every gift-card offer carries a non-empty risks array

cards.title: Curated gift-card and cashback feeds
cards.description: Woolworths/Everyday Rewards, Coles/Flybuys or Velocity, ShopBack and Prezzee tracked as versioned curated offers with expiry windows and verification status. Collector stubs must fail closed.
acceptance: current_offers.json and history.json validate
Every entry has source_url, starts_at, ends_at and verification_status
An unverified source produces no published offer and logs why
Expired offers are moved to history automatically

cards.title: Publish deal and gift-card feeds
cards.description: Write data/deals/current_deals.json and history.json plus gift-card current offers for the site contract, with stable sort and expiry handling.
acceptance: Feeds validate and are ordered deterministically
Deals reference only published offers
History append is idempotent across repeated runs in one day

cards.title: Design system: layout, tokens, navigation, disclaimers
cards.description: The shared shell: header, nav, footer with the not-affiliated disclaimer, price-freshness badge, responsive type scale and accessibility baseline.
acceptance: Layouts render at 320px, 768px and 1440px without horizontal scroll
Every page includes the freshnes/disclaimer slot and a last-checked component
Keyboard focus is visible on every interactive element
Colour contrast passes WCAG AA
No layout shift when the freshness badge loads

cards.title: Home page
cards.description: Hero with top verified deals, biggest drops, education savings, gift-card opportunities, recently updated products and the trust notice.
acceptance: Every module renders empty states when its feed is empty, never placeholder prices
Top deals are filtered to verified + fresh only
Data-freshness notice shows the true last collection time

cards.title: Product catalogue with search, filters and sort
cards.description: Catalogue page with a prebuilt JSON index, URL-param filters and deterministic sorting.
acceptance: Search works offline from a prebuilt index under 20KB gzipped
Filters: category, family, seller, price range, stock, education, pickup; all shareable via URL
Sort: price, discount, price drop, recently updated
Back button restores the previous filter state
Baseline listing renders without JavaScript

cards.title: Product detail with chart and route optimiser
cards.description: The main conversion page: specs, RRP, education price, best retail, best effective, all offers, price history, stock history, ranked purchase routes and direct retailer links.
acceptance: uPlot chart is lazy-loaded and renders from data/history
Every offer row shows seller, price, stock, captured_at and source link
Optimiser ranks retail, education, gift-card and cashback routes with eligibility and expiry warnings
EPP and trade-in are off unless the visitor enables and configures them
Stale offers render the indicative label and cannot win best price

cards.title: Deals page
cards.description: Current drops, sales, clearance, bundles, all-time lows and gift-card opportunities, each with evidence and expiry.
acceptance: Each deal card shows type, saving, confidence, source and captured time
Expired deals are excluded
Empty state per section

cards.title: Education page
cards.description: Education pricing comparison, eligibility explanation, annual limits and education-specific deals.
acceptance: Eligibility categories and verification vendor shown verbatim from the data
Education price is never merged into the best retail price
Comparison table states the saving in AUD and percent

cards.title: Gift cards page
cards.description: Apple gift-card offers, retailer gift cards, cashback, effective-price calculator, historical best rates and risk warnings.
acceptance: Calculator runs entirely client-side from published data
Risk and expiry warnings appear beside the offer, not buried
Points are labelled as points, never as cash

cards.title: Business and education page
cards.description: Procurement routes presented as quote/procurement/service options: Apple Business Store, ABM/VPP, Trade In, and the education and business reseller directory.
acceptance: No consumer price is shown for a quote-based route
Every entry links to an official quote or contact page
Distinct visual treatment from consumer deals

cards.title: Browser-local watchlist
cards.description: Watchlist stored in localStorage with no account and no network calls.
acceptance: Add/remove works across reloads
No PII and no cookies
Empty state explains the alerts roadmap
Clearing works

cards.title: SEO, structured data and feeds
cards.description: Metadata, canonical URLs, Product and Offer JSON-LD, sitemap and a deals RSS feed.
acceptance: JSON-LD validates for product pages
Sitemap lists all indexable pages
RSS validates
Canonicals are absolute

cards.title: Accessibility and Lighthouse gate
cards.description: Automated accessibility and performance gate on the built site.
acceptance: Lighthouse >=95 for performance, accessibility, SEO on home and product detail
axe reports zero violations
Gate runs in CI

cards.title: Seven collection and deployment workflows
cards.description: update-apple, update-retailers, update-gift-cards, update-deals, deploy-site, validate-data, nightly-full-refresh with jitter, concurrency limits, per-job isolation and artefacts.
acceptance: actionlint passes on all seven
Each has workflow_dispatch and a documented schedule
A failure in one retailer job does not fail the others
Commit step only commits changed data files with conventional messages
Priority subset runs in under 5 minutes

cards.title: Deployment gate: validate before publish
cards.description: deploy-site depends on validate-data. A schema failure must provably block deployment.
acceptance: A deliberately broken dataset blocks the deploy (proven on a branch)
Pages artefact upload is atomic
Deploy records the data commit SHA in the page footer

cards.title: Discord alerts with dedupe
cards.description: Alert selection using config/alerts.yml thresholds, rendered to Discord with all required fields, deduped via data/alerts/sent.json. Missing webhook is a warning, not a failure.
acceptance: Every alert includes product, seller, current, previous, saving, effective, source, captured, expiry, link
Repeat runs send zero duplicates
Missing secret exits 0 with a warning
Alert selection logic is unit-tested against fixtures

cards.title: Run summaries and failure diagnostics
cards.description: Job summaries with per-source counts, failures and review-queue delta; diagnostics uploaded on failure.
acceptance: Summary renders on every run
Failure artefacts contain the raw response and the parser error
No secrets appear in logs or artefacts

cards.title: Operations runbook
cards.description: docs/OPERATIONS.md plus COLLECTION-RUNBOOK, DEPLOYMENT, TESTING and alerts guidance.
acceptance: A new operator can run, debug and roll back from the docs alone
Every failure mode in the risk register has a runbook entry
Docs reference real commands that work

cards.title: Adapter health checks and staleness alerting
cards.description: Per-adapter success rate, last success and fixture drift detection, surfaced as data and as an alert.
acceptance: adapter_health.json validates and is published
A source silent for beyond its threshold raises an alert
Fixture drift is detected when markup changes

cards.title: Data-quality report
cards.description: Coverage, match confidence, staleness and unmatched counts, published as a page and a doc.
acceptance: Counts are computed from data, not estimated
Report renders on the site and in docs/reports/
Regressions are visible without reading CI logs

cards.title: Snapshot retention and repository size guard
cards.description: 90-day snapshot retention with compact derived series and a CI size guard.
acceptance: Retention job prunes only snapshots older than the window
History series survive pruning
CI fails if the repo exceeds the budget

cards.title: Launch checklist and final documentation
cards.description: Complete the documentation set, the legal disclaimers, the roadmap and the launch checklist.
acceptance: All sixteen documents exist and are current
Legal disclaimers reviewed against WA/AU comparison-site expectations
Launch checklist has an owner and a date per item
